zh:
本版本汇总 SpaceMouse、六维力传感器、Pico 和主从臂的接入能力，统一提供安装、读取、机器人接入和配置说明。

### SpaceMouse

- C++ / Python 读取六自由度输入和按键；提供设备探测及原始输入查看程序。
- 机器人应用通过 SDK Peripheral 样本接口上传输入；预编译 SDK bridge 包提供对应程序。

### 六维力传感器

- C++ / Python 读取力与力矩数据，提供串口配置、读取示例和设备权限说明。
- 提供 SDK Peripheral 接入和静态标定应用。

### Pico

- C++ / Python 读取头显及双手柄位姿、按键和追踪状态；通过 WebXR 接入，提供 USB adb 转发步骤。
- 提供 B3 双臂 ServoP 遥操源码示例，包含 Grip 离合、J6 摇杆、DH 夹爪控制、奇异位形减速和断流停止；Python 启动入口复用 C++ 程序。
- 示例内置 B3 支架变换。遥操构建需要包含 `sdk/dual_arm_robot.hpp` 及匹配运行库的 C++ SDK；发布配套 SDK 0.2.0 包未提供该头文件，Pico 遥操程序不包含在预编译包中。

### 主从臂

- Python 读取主臂六轴输入，并通过机器人 Python SDK ServoJ 驱动从臂。
- 示例采用主臂与单臂 i3 的标定映射，提供相对起点跟随、可选起点对齐和输入超时停止；更换硬件需核对标定。

### 安装与兼容性

- 提供 Ubuntu 22.04 / Linux x86_64 C++ 包及 CPython 3.10、3.11、3.12 wheel。
- 基础外设库独立于机器人 SDK；SDK bridge 包包含 SpaceMouse、六维力接入程序及 SDK 0.2.0 运行库。两个 C++ 包按用途选择一个。
- 提供中英文在线文档、PDF / HTML 说明书和 SHA256 校验和。下载包保留用户指南与示例，维护工具和过程记录留在源码历史中。
- 机器人应用为指定构型的示例；运行前核对安装、标定、工具和工作区，在目标硬件上完成现场验证。

此前的开发版本与制品可在 [历史 Releases](https://github.com/smore-robotics/smrcore_peripherals/releases) 查询。
en:
This release consolidates SpaceMouse, force/torque sensor, Pico and master–follower integration with installation, input reading, robot connection and configuration guides.

### SpaceMouse

- Read six-degree-of-freedom input and buttons in C++ or Python, with device probing and raw-input inspection tools.
- Forward samples through the robot SDK Peripheral interface using the prebuilt SDK bridge application.

### Force/torque sensor

- Read force and torque in C++ or Python, with serial configuration, reader examples and device permission guides.
- Use SDK Peripheral integration and static calibration applications.

### Pico

- Read headset and controller poses, buttons and tracking state in C++ or Python over WebXR; USB adb forwarding instructions are included.
- The B3 dual-arm ServoP source example includes Grip clutching, J6 thumbstick control, DH grippers, singularity slowdown and stale-input stopping. The Python launcher reuses the C++ application.
- The example embeds B3 mounting transforms. Teleoperation requires a C++ SDK containing `sdk/dual_arm_robot.hpp` and matching runtime libraries. The pinned SDK 0.2.0 package omits that header, so prebuilt archives do not include the Pico teleoperation binary.

### Master–follower arms

- Read six-axis master input in Python and drive the follower through the robot Python SDK ServoJ interface.
- The example uses a calibrated master/single-i3 mapping with relative startup anchors, optional initial alignment and stale-input stopping. Review calibration when changing hardware.

### Installation and compatibility

- C++ archives target Ubuntu 22.04 / Linux x86_64; wheels support CPython 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12.
- The peripheral reader library is independent of the robot SDK. The SDK bridge archive adds SpaceMouse and force/torque applications with the SDK 0.2.0 runtime. Choose one C++ archive for your use case.
- Bilingual online documentation, PDF / HTML manuals and SHA256 checksums are provided. Download archives contain user guides and examples; maintenance tools and development records remain in source history.
- Robot applications are configuration-specific examples. Check mounting, calibration, tooling and workspace, and validate on the target hardware before deployment.

Earlier development versions and assets remain available in [historical Releases](https://github.com/smore-robotics/smrcore_peripherals/releases).
